_comment: Kiln's own instance of the asset budget, so the mechanism is exercised
through nix and not only through tools/asset_budget.py's selftest. The
numbers are MEASURED from the three model-* outputs, not chosen: alien
240 tris / 480 verts, cone 42 / 45, checker 4 / 8. The ceilings sit
exactly on the measurement, which is what makes this fixture useful --
any change to those models' geometry turns this red and has to be
Note alien and checker both ship 2.0 vertices per triangle where cone
ships 1.07. That ratio is the thing a triangle count hides, and it is
why `verts` is a first-class ceiling here rather than a derived note.
